artifacts.summary: Empirically establishes the root cause of missing summary metadata headers: general-implementation-agent.md's own Stage 6 inline template has never matched summary-format.md, and this conflicting template wins over two already-standing, already-ignored advisory checks (Stage 4b format injection, and a real-time PostToolUse hook). Also finds a broken validate-artifact.sh --fix anchor bug (reproduced live) and a hard-mode postflight-validation asymmetry, then recommends a non-blocking-but-effective enforcement posture with justification.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent system, an implementation/research agent's own concrete inline writing-stage template (e.g. 'Stage 6: Create X' with a literal skeleton) silently wins over an earlier cross-referenced or even freshly-injected format spec in the same prompt, when the two conflict. Advisory format-compliance checks (postflight validators, PostToolUse hooks) can be already-standing and already-firing on 100% of runs and still fail to produce compliance, because nothing tells the agent to reconcile a concrete in-procedure template against separately-injected reference prose. When diagnosing a 'validator keeps failing' defect, check the writing agent's own inline template FIRST, before assuming the reference doc is unread or a validator is missing.

scripts/validate-artifact.sh's --fix auto-repair anchors on the last line matching '^- \*\*' (a bulleted bold-text line) to insert missing metadata fields after. Real summary artifacts use bare '**Field**:' lines with no leading bullet, so this anchor search instead matches an unrelated bold bullet elsewhere in the document (e.g. in a 'What Changed' or 'Verification' section) and the subsequent multi-line sed -i insertion can crash under set -euo pipefail on ordinary prose (e.g. an em dash), aborting before the script's own [PASS]/[FAIL] summary prints. --fix should not be trusted as a safety net for summary artifacts until this anchor/escaping logic is corrected.
